data.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.description: Steel hounds are proficient with simple weapons, plus the rapier, the sap, and one type of firearm selected at 1st level. They are proficient in light armor, but not shields. This replaces the investigator's weapon and armor proficiencies.
